{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
sales_df = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv')

# Convert revenue to float
sales_df['revenue'] = pd.to_numeric(sales_df['revenue'], errors='coerce')

# Check for any invalid revenue values
print("Invalid revenue values (NaN or negative):", sales_df['revenue'].isna().sum(), "NaN,", (sales_df['revenue'] < 0).sum(), "negative")

# Ensure only completed orders are used
completed_df = sales_df[sales_df['status'] == 'completed']

# Check conversion rate for each channel
email_conv_rate = completed_df[completed_df['channel'] == 'email']['converted'].mean()
paid_search_conv_rate = completed_df[completed_df['channel'] == 'paid_search']['converted'].mean()

# Compute the difference in conversion rates
rate_diff = email_conv_rate - paid_search_conv_rate

# Output results
print(f"Email conversion rate: {email_conv_rate:.4f}")
print(f"Paid search conversion rate: {paid_search_conv_rate:.4f}")
print(f"Difference (email - paid_search): {rate_diff:.4f}")

# Return the difference
rate_diff"}
